purpose: mandatory falsification after three LOW-confidence verification routes

exact_claim.domain: Digit source MNIST+USPS to target SVHN, top-label ECE percent
exact_claim.quantifier: Each printed mean and standard deviation is reported as derived from ten runs.

valid_falsification_requires: a counterexample matching every released data, architecture, objective, optimizer, and ten-run assumption
independent raw-prediction recomputation for all six compared cells
a contradiction of the historical aggregate rather than a different stochastic realization
verdict_rule: FALSIFIED only if a valid counterexample meets every condition. Otherwise BLOCKED after recording all four routes and exact external unblock requirements.
